reason: I reproduced the estimate: 0.58 (SE 0.233, p=0.013) with full pre-treatment controls. The report correctly leaves out the post-treatment mgmt_rating_2023 and states the selection-on-observables caveat. The result is robust to a quadratic term (which is insignificant), to splitting by sector, and to interactions. The claim of a modest positive effect is appropriately hedged.
